brief: The cluster is acting up. You need answers fast — before production goes down.
brief_id: Cluster bermasalah. Anda butuh jawaban cepat — sebelum produksi down.

scenes.text: It's 9 AM. Taylor gets a ping from the ops team — something's off with the OCP cluster.

id.text: Pukul 9 pagi. Taylor dapat pesan dari tim ops — ada yang tidak beres dengan cluster OCP.

scenes.text: Taylor, pods in production are restarting. I can't tell if it's the cluster or the app.

id.text: Taylor, pod di production terus restart. Saya tidak tahu masalahnya di cluster atau di aplikasinya.

scenes.text: Cluster health, workloads, registry, routes — I need the full picture before I touch anything.

id.text: Kesehatan cluster, workload, registry, route — saya butuh gambaran lengkap sebelum melakukan apa pun.

scenes.text: Have you tried Bob? He can run the full health check for you.

id.text: Sudah coba Bob? Dia bisa jalankan health check lengkap buat kamu.

scenes.problem: Run a full OCP health check — cluster, workloads, registry, routes.

id.problem: Jalankan OCP health check lengkap — cluster, workload, registry, route.

options.label: Ask Bob to run the OCP health check
options.outcome: Full OCP health check complete. Issues identified, next steps clear. ✓

id_text.label: Minta Bob jalankan OCP health check
id_text.outcome: OCP health check selesai. Masalah teridentifikasi, langkah selanjutnya jelas. ✓

scenes.text: Payment service is back up! That was fast, Taylor.

id.text: Payment service sudah normal! Cepat banget, Taylor.

scenes.text: It's not about knowing every command by heart. It's about having the right co-pilot.

id.text: Bukan soal hafal semua perintah. Tapi soal punya co-pilot yang tepat.

scenes.text:
Cluster login. Full health scan. Remediation plan. Post-fix verification.

What used to take an hour of digging — done in minutes. That's ops at full speed.

id.text:
Login cluster. Scan kesehatan lengkap. Rencana remediasi. Verifikasi pasca-perbaikan.

Yang biasanya butuh satu jam penggalian — selesai dalam menit. Itulah ops di kecepatan penuh.
